CORRECTIONS REQUIRED
An audit of the primary extraction against the facsimile pages of The Greek New Testament: SBL Edition (ed. Michael W. Holmes) confirms that the text and locators are grounded in the source, but identifies one diacritical and symbol precision requiring correction in the apparatus entry for 1 Corinthians 6:16.
Itemized Audit & Verification
1. Diacritical and Lemma Marker Correction: 1 Corinthians 6:16 (P01F-P009)
Previous Extraction:
Apparatus entry was given as 16 ἦ WH Treg NIV ] – RP.
Source Reading:
The printed apparatus on page 344 reads: 16 ⸀ἢ WH Treg NIV ] – RP
1
.
Correction:
The Greek disjunctive particle is ἢ (smooth breathing and grave accent), not ἦ (circumflex).
The leading single-word variation marker ⸀ was omitted from the apparatus entry transcription in previous turns.
Verification of Primary Extraction Details
A. Direct Verification of Statements of Absence ("No Apparatus Entry")
